crossRefs.note: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them…
What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t…
“ ‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of…
Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that…
or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.
When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.
But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order…
If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving…
What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has…
Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me. New moons, Sabbaths, and convocations: I can’t stand…
My soul hates your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They are a burden to me. I am weary of bearing them.
“Cry aloud! Don’t spare! Lift up your voice like a trumpet! Declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house…
Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods that you have…
then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, ‘We are delivered,’ that you may do…
not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as…

translations.web: But in giving you this command, I don’t praise you, that you come together not for the better but for the worse.
translations.bsb: In the following instructions I have no praise to offer, because your gatherings do more harm than good.
translations.kjv: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.
translations.asv: But in giving you this charge, I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better but for the worse.
